title: No type alias for DkimSigner generic type — repeated at every declaration site
description: The type Arc<mail_auth::dkim::DkimSigner<mail_auth::common::crypto::Ed25519Key, mail_auth::dkim::Done>> appears verbatim at 6+ sites: NntpQueue field, SmtpRelayQueue field, NntpQueue::new param, SmtpRelayQueue::new param, main.rs binding, test helpers. No type alias is defined. This will fossilize: a contributor adding a new use site must copy all four type parameters correctly. A type alias in a shared location (e.g. a pub type in queue.rs or a lib.rs re-export) would enforce consistency.
